question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Vexatious**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Pleasant .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **vexatious** means causing annoyance, frustration, or worry.
 
• An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning.
 
• Among the options provided:
 
 
• **Option 1:** Pleasant - This means enjoyable and satisfying, which is opposite to vexatious.
 
• **Option 2:** Annoying - Synonym for vexatious.
 
• **Option 3:** Troublesome - Synonym for vexatious.
 
• **Option 4:** Irritating - Synonym for vexatious.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym is **Option 1: Pleasant**.

Correct sentence: *The most appropriate antonym of the word vexatious is **Pleasant**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms:** Annoying, troublesome, irritating.
 
• **Antonyms:** Pleasant, enjoyable, delightful.
